definitions.explanation: The degree to which something (typically medicine, treatment, or an action) produces the desired result. Often used for tangible, observable effects.

examples.japanese: {効|き}き{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{時間|じかん}がかかる→時間がかかる：26082_jikangakakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes time for the effect to appear.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{効|き}き{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じて→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧。
examples.english: I went into the exam believing in the power of my good-luck charm.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{効|き}く→効く：01932_kiku⟧ (to work, to be effective) + ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧ (result, appearance). Most commonly used with medicine, remedies, and treatments, but also applies to charms, strategies, and other actions where one hopes for a tangible result.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {効|き}き{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — to be effective, to have an effect
- {効|き}き{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — to have no effect
- {効|き}き{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ — the effect appears/kicks in
- {効|き}き{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ — the effect is weak
- {効|き}き{目|め}⟦{抜群|ばつぐん}→抜群：12783_batsugun⟧ — outstandingly effective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧ — effect, result; more formal, used in scientific and official contexts
- ⟦{効能|こうのう}→効能：11920_kounou⟧ — efficacy; formal, often seen on medicine labels
- ⟦{効力|こうりょく}→効力：11824_kouryoku⟧ — effectiveness, potency; formal, often legal or regulatory
